name: warpos
description: WarpOS — autonomous AI operating system for software engineering. Registry-driven hooks, transactional updates, honest release gates, generic promotion.
notes: Dispatch-stdin fix. Phase 0 (b3a5ab06) converted runProvider's execSync to spawnSync to capture stderr for silent-zero-byte-death telemetry but shipped an incompatible call shape: encoding:'buffer' with a STRING input. Node requires Buffer-typed input when encoding is 'buffer' and throws ERR_UNKNOWN_ENCODING synchronously before the CLI is invoked. Every diff-model review across the framework (gauntlet, sprint planning, redteam, qa, compliance) silently failed at the dispatch layer; callers misattributed to LRN-2026-04-17 cmd.exe stdin or fell back to self-review. 0.4.4 wraps the input in Buffer.from(promptContent, 'utf8') — single-line change in scripts/hooks/lib/providers.js. Test added at scripts/test-providers-stdin-fix.js (3/3 ok, validates buggy shape still throws and fix roundtrips). Re-bootstrap product repos to receive the fix.
